statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The service was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with underlying arrhythmic activity
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
